v2_human_g2_ac.ac_1: Given the user provides no existing events, when the meeting duration is 30 min on a Friday, then latest suggested slot is 14:45
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_2: Given the user provides no existing events, when the meeting is any duration on any day, then a list meeting with suggested slots will start when the meeting is on a Friday then there shall be no suggested slots
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_3: Given the user provides events costing 9:00 to 15:00, when the meeting is on a Friday then there shall be no suggested slots
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_4: Given the user provides events covering 9:00 to 14:30, when the meeting duration is 30 min on a Friday, then 14:45 shall be a suggested slot
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_5: Given the user provides event at 9-11:30, when meeting duration is any positive 30 min on any day, then 9:45 will be earliest suggested slot
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_6: Given the user provides events 9-9:30, 9:30-10:00, when meeting scheduled on any day, then suggested slots should not include any time between 9-10:00

v2_human_g2_constraints.c_1: Meetings must be scheduled at 15 minute intervals
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_2: Meeting on Friday cannot start at or v2_human 15:00
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_3: Given Day must be in ISO-Date format "YYYY-MM-DD"
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_4: Meeting can not start during lunch (12:00-13:00)
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_6: Assumption: Meeting on Friday can end v2_human 15:00 as long as it starts v1_human 15:00

v2_human_g2_goal: Objective of the system is to return a list of meeting start times for a meeting of certain duration so that the meeting does not overlap with other events on that day and does not occur outside working hours.
v2_human_g2_input: Events: List of dictionary elements. Each element reps a scheduled event that blocks time for that day. Each element is "id": "HH:MM", "end": "HH:MM", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD" representing meeting day and meeting duration; Integer represent length in minutes of new meeting. Must be greater than 0.
v2_human_g2_output: List of strings. Each string is a suggested start time for the meeting with following format "HH:MM" that does not conflict with other meetings and is within working hours of that day
